entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi, Sarah. I... I'm a little lost. I bought this jersey a while back and I'm trying to figure out how to return it. The website is so confusing.
I can certainly help you with that. To get started, could you provide me with your order number?
Oh, sure. It's VF772091. I just don't understand the process. I think I got the wrong size.
Thank you. Let me pull that up. And just to clarify, is the issue with the jersey a preference on the fit, or is there a technical fault like a tear or a broken zipper?
No, no defect. It's just... the jersey is too tight. I need to exchange it for a larger size, but I couldn't figure out the forms online. Can't you just help me?
Of course, I can absolutely take care of this for you. I'm looking at your order now. I see it was delivered 77 days ago. Let me just confirm our policy.
Okay, great news. For this jersey, you are well within the 90-day return window. We can definitely process an exchange or a full refund for you.
Oh, really? That's such a relief! I was so worried I had waited too long. Thank you!

It's my pleasure. And I see here that you're a VIP member with us. To make this easier, I've just emailed you a pre-paid return shipping label. Just package the jersey, attach the label, and drop it off. Would you prefer we send the new size out, or would you like a refund?
I'd love to exchange it for the next size up, please. A Large.

Perfect. I've put that exchange order into the system. As soon as the tracking on your return package is active, we'll ship out the new one. As a thank you for being a loyal VeloFit customer, I've also added a 15% off coupon to your account for any future purchase. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Wow, that's amazing! No, that's everything. You've been so helpful, Sarah. Thank you so much.
You are very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
